category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly reduce maxlen to 48, learning rate to 0.0004 and dropout to 0.10. Training history p95 is at most 39, so shorter inputs should reduce padding computation; smaller updates and reduced dropout may stabilize the existing normalized embeddings. Existing checkpoint metadata records MAXLEN, and the generated predictor reads it. Preserve model width, depth, loss, scoring, batch size, seeds and training caps. Enforce the required DATA_DIR lookup.

change_summary: Set shared maxlen=48, learning rate=0.0004 and dropout=0.10. Preserve one GRU4Rec checkpoint per category and existing metadata-driven inference; require GAGC_DATA_DIR.
